name: amira-mcp-server
description: Read-only access to AMIRA, the Africa Multiple research-data platform on Omeka S.
long_description:
The Africa Multiple Interactive Research Atlas (AMIRA) is the research-data platform of the Africa Multiple Cluster of Excellence at the University of Bayreuth. It is built and maintained by the Cluster's Digital Research Environment (DRE), its digital infrastructure unit, which connects researchers across the Africa Multiple Research Centres (AMRCs) and partner institutions worldwide.

Curation and description are joint efforts with partners at the AMRCs in Université Joseph Ki-Zerbo, Rhodes University, the University of Lagos, and Moi University. Bayreuth hosts the coordinating DRE infrastructure and metadata layer. Federal University of Bahia is a privileged partner, not an AMRC. Storage stays distributed by default: research data remains in local repositories and becomes findable without being relocated.

This read-only MCP server exposes AMIRA's Omeka S metadata through well-described tools for research items, projects, research sections, people, institutions, groups, collections, publications (open-access ones with searchable extracted full text), journals, podcast episodes, YouTube videos and searchable transcripts, plus the places, languages and subjects that connect them. No API key, database, account or VPN is required. A complete data snapshot is bundled in the extension, so the server works fully offline; when enabled, it can refresh from the public Omeka S API.

Every record carries an `amira_url` — its public page on the Omeka S site — so results can be cited as links back to the source. AMIRA focuses on the Cluster's research data; for news, events and general information, visit https://www.africamultiple.uni-bayreuth.de/.

tools.name: get_collection_overview
tools.description: Counts and breakdowns across the whole collection + snapshot freshness. Start here. Renders as a dashboard in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: search_research_items
tools.description: Search ~4,000 research items by keyword, subject, location, country, contributor, project, section, university, resource type, format/genre, language, and year.

tools.name: get_research_item
tools.description: Full metadata for one research item by Omeka o:id: dates, contributors with roles, places with hierarchy, sponsors, formats, collections, related items, media thumbnail.

tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Search the cluster's research projects by keyword, university, section, PI, member, or funding institution.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Full detail for one project, with item breakdown and top subjects.

tools.name: list_research_sections
tools.description: The cluster's thematic sections with funding phases, PIs and counts. Renders as a funding-phase Gantt in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: get_research_section
tools.description: Full detail for one research section, including its projects.

tools.name: search_persons
tools.description: Search the people authority list by name (either order) or affiliation.

tools.name: get_person
tools.description: Profile aggregating a person's projects led/joined, items contributed, and publications.

tools.name: list_institutions
tools.description: List institutions with project counts, partner categories, and coordinates.

tools.name: get_institution
tools.description: One institution's or group's projects, affiliated people, and contributed items.

tools.name: list_cluster_partners
tools.description: List Africa Multiple partner institutions by category: AMRC, privileged partner, cooperation partners, and global partner centres.

tools.name: list_groups
tools.description: List research groups.

tools.name: list_subjects
tools.description: Subject headings (tags merged in) ranked by item frequency, each with its authority page.

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: Every place — countries and cities in one flat list (hierarchy rolled up) — ranked by item count, with coordinates.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: Collections (item sets) ranked by research-item count, each with its browsable page.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Facet values: formats/genres, languages, resource types.

tools.name: list_years
tools.description: Date histogram of research items by year or decade — coverage over time and the most-covered year/decade. Renders as an interactive chart in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: search_publications
tools.description: Search the cluster bibliography by keyword, author, type, venue, or year — keyword reaches into the extracted full text of open-access publications.

tools.name: get_publication
tools.description: Full metadata and BibTeX for one publication; extracted PDF full text opt-in via include_fulltext, with offset/length paging.

tools.name: list_journals
tools.description: The journals the cluster publishes in, ranked by publication count, with ISSN and country.

tools.name: find_related
tools.description: Cross-entity discovery: pivot from a subject/place/person/project to co-occurring entities. Renders as a radial hub in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: search_podcasts
tools.description: Search cluster podcast episodes by keyword, series, person, or year — including full-text search over transcripts.

tools.name: get_podcast
tools.description: Full detail for one podcast episode; transcript opt-in via include_transcript, with offset/length paging.

tools.name: search_videos
tools.description: Search the cluster's YouTube videos — including full-text search over transcripts, with a match snippet.

tools.name: get_video
tools.description: Full detail for one video; transcript opt-in via include_transcript, with offset/length paging.

live_refresh.title: Refresh data from the live site
live_refresh.description: When on, the server checks the public Omeka S API for newer data at startup and periodically while running, then updates its local cache. Turn off to run fully offline using only the bundled snapshot.

cache_dir.title: Refreshed-data cache directory
cache_dir.description: Where to store data refreshed from the site. Leave default to use your home directory (~/.amira-mcp/cache).

site_base.title: Site base URL (advanced)
site_base.description: Override the Omeka S site base URL used for citations and refresh. Leave as-is unless you are pointing the extension at another Omeka S instance.
